data.revised_prompt:
Strict 16:9 horizontal image. Use the user-provided traditional Chinese opera images as the primary visual base: preserve the authentic xiqu headwear logic, including black forehead hair patches, opera makeup structure, blue-white-pink bead flowers, red pom-poms, pearl ornaments, long curved pheasant-feather / lingzi arcs, tassels, water sleeves, and performance gesture. Transform these into a new high-design Guochao styling concept for an Eastern Suburb Memory Chinese opera styling experience pavilion. The result should be a fresh design effect image, not a copy of the reference photo. Photorealistic fashion editorial, premium concept rendering, Chinese opera heritage plus contemporary styling, industrial red-brick Chengdu setting. No text, no watermark, no logo, no Japanese elements, no kimono, no samurai, no generic hanfu, no cheap costume, no plastic skin.

Create a new design concept based on the first and fourth references: a modern danjiao phoenix-crown hairstyle. Keep the authentic opera facial language: black forehead hair patches, pink eye shadow, clean white-pink complexion, precise red lip, long black side hair strands. Transform the headwear into a contemporary blue-white-pink phoenix crown hair design: sculpted black hair base, silver-blue hard crown frame, pearl sprays, blue enamel flower clusters, pink silk flower pads, small red bead drops, long delicate tassels beside the cheeks. Costume: modern light-blue and white xiqu-inspired jacket with embroidered sleeve panels, not a sweater, not a wedding dress. Setting: East Suburb Memory industrial styling studio, red brick, black pipe, mirror lights softened in background. Composition: half-body portrait with headwear fully visible, enough negative space on left for pitch deck, 35mm lens, premium design effect image. Lighting: bright soft 4000K key, transparent shadows, all bead and hair details visible.
